draft.prompt: According to Genesis 9, what sign does God place in the cloud in the covenant with Noah?

claims.text: In Genesis 9, God identifies the rainbow as the sign of the covenant described to Noah. The passage connects this sign with remembering the covenant between God and living creatures.

labelRationale: Genesis 9:13-16 explicitly names the rainbow as the covenant sign. This fixture only checks the named text, not independent history.
